messages:
anya (product): Quick sync — customer-driven asks landed from two enterprise trials. We need to fence the observability surface for the upcoming console launch. Short list: dashboards (per-route cost + error), tracing hooks (span attrs + sampling tier), cost breakdown (model-level), and error analytics (grouping + reproduction hints).
sam (eng): Agreed. Can we push some items to post-launch? What's mandatory for MVP vs nice-to-have?
lina (cs): Enterprise A requires per-route token cost and a hard link to billing events — they flagged this as a blocker for procurement. Enterprise B wants session-level error grouping (stack + request payload sample).
mike (sre): From an ops perspective mandatory: basic dashboards (latency, errors, cost rate) and tracing hooks at minimal sampling for SLOs. Anything requiring full request payloads or full traces should be opt-in.
anya (product): Proposal: MVP (launch): - Dashboards: per-model and per-route aggregated cost, 95/99 latency, error rate. - Tracing: lightweight span hooks (no payload), configurable sampling, default 5%. - Error analytics: surface top error types + first-seen. Post-launch v1: per-route token cost attribution, payload-linked reproduction, session grouping. Thoughts?
sam (eng): Implementation notes: we can emit these as structured events to telemetry pipeline. Example event schema sketch: ```json
{"route":"/v1/completions","model":"redwood-8b-q4","cost_tokens":42,"latency_ms":123,"error":"timeout"}``` Sampling gate is simple. 5% default cheap.
mike (sre): Sampling config needs runtime toggle + rollout flag for Dedicated/Private customers. Also add a fail-safe: if telemetry pipeline lags >30s, auto-drop high-cardinality fields.
lina (cs): Can we surface a per-customer toggle in the Console for turning on payload capture? Some legal/regulatory customers need explicit opt-in.
anya (product): Yes — add opt-in toggle and audit log in Console as acceptance criteria for payload capture.
sam (eng): Can we scope acceptance criteria for launch? My checklist suggestion: 1) Dashboards implemented and linked to tenant filter 2) Tracing hooks emit schema with sampling toggle 3) Cost widget shows model+route split (approximate) 4) Error table with grouping and link-to-request (if opted-in) 5) Docs + quickstart.
mike (sre): Add SLO smoke test: synthetic load that verifies dashboard latency metrics update within 90s and sampling toggle takes effect within 2 minutes.
anya (product): Good. Lina — can you validate Enterprise A will accept "approximate per-route cost" for launch if we commit to per-route token accounting in v1?
lina (cs): I'll confirm but odds are high they accept approximate now if we backfill accurate billing in v1 and show timeline.
anya (product): OK team — action items: Sam: sketch minimal event schema + sampling config PR by EOD Thursday. Mike: SLO smoke test plan + fail-safe doc. Lina: customer confirmation + procurement note. I'll draft launch gating doc with these acceptance criteria and circulate. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder — staging deploy scheduled 1754180000 for the telemetry pipeline update.
anya (product): Thanks — we'll aim to have the gating doc in #product by tomorrow noon.
